note: The faction match's horror look (MatchTable.md): the post grade at round 1 and at the last round, mixed by how far the match has run; the lamp's flicker; the figures' shadows. No red grade (the user, 2026-11-20).

rooms.note: Floor tiles by square kind (a path, art/floors/*.jpg) or room paintings (a bare name, art/rooms/<name>.jpg); one per kind on a board, picked by the board's size. Walls rise as the camera comes within roomDistance. Since the stage opens at about 10 tiles across (about 5 m), walls only rise nearer than that (boardDistance 5.5 to roomDistance 3).

walk.note: Figures walk square by square to where the rules put them (display only).

figures.note: A figure is 'base' tall (times 3 x 0.625 m) and keeps that size: zooming out makes it look smaller (the user, 2026-11-25 note 1).

battle.note: The battle view (Octopath, the user 2026-11-25): one fixed wide shot of both sides, 'across' tiles wide, the sides at 25% and 75% ('gap' = a quarter of it). The camera stands 'near' farther back since the fighters stand that much nearer it; seconds is the way in and out, follow the pan onto the stage. A blow: the striker steps 'step' tiles toward the middle and back over stepSeconds; a move's push-in is 'punch' of its board strength, with no turn. A foe that never rises dissolves dieAfter seconds after its fall is told.

reach.note: The player's reach and targets wash the tile half over in their colour, blinking.

moves.note: A move's camera (feedback 2026-11-24 15:10, note 10): by motion, a push-in to nearer x the distance and a turn of yaw degrees toward the side the mover faces, rising and falling over seconds.

talk.note: A stage scene's close-up on its speaker: the seat comes to near (table) or roomNear (room view) of its distance and looks lift x the figure's size above the feet, so heads stay in (2026-11-25 note 3).

hd2d.note: The HD-2D look (plan 2026-11-25-hd2d-polish.md, the user chose a light blur): dof is the tilt-shift's blur far from the sharp band, in screen heights (engine Post.md 6c); dofWidth half the band's height. The band follows whoever acts. The diorama (task 4): the board stands on a plinth 'depth' deep and 'rim' wider, its top edge lit gold (edgeGlow), on black velvet; plinthArt (when made) covers its sides. Each room has a warm lamp lampHeight over its middle, the centre a cold one, at most 'lamps' (lampPower, lampRange in tiles).
